description: Points a florist's own domain at their Trellis shop (one A record on the bare domain and one CNAME on www) and adds the records that let the shop send email from send.<domain>. Existing email records are not touched: nothing is written on the bare domain's mail.
variableDescription: %ip%: the IPv4 address the hosting company gives for the bare domain. %wwwtarget%: the host name the hosting company gives for www. %dkim%: the DKIM public key the email service gives for send.<domain> (the base64 part after p=). %mailfrom%: the mail server the email service gives for bounces on send.send.<domain>.
